questions.question_bn: Rest energy mc²=6 J। total relativistic energy 2mc² হলে kinetic energy কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Total E=K+mc²। K=2mc²−mc²=mc²=nJ; total ও kinetic energy আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Closedpipeat 273Kfundamental 9 Hz। at1092Klengthconstant,soundspeed∝√T। fundamental কত Hz?

questions.question_bn: α=0.98,I emitter 9mA। Ibase কত mA?

questions.question_bn: Mass 7 kg at6 m/s hitsstationarymass 14 kg (2×7);1Delastic। first mass final velocity কত m/s?

questions.question_bn: Series RLC-এ L=6H,C=1/6F। resonance angular frequency কত rad/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Resonance XL=XC⇒ω²LC=1। LC=(6)·1/(6)=1⇒ω₀=1rad/s।

questions.question_bn: Twoidenticalcellsε=9 V,r2ΩparallelwithloadR 1Ω। load current কত A?

questions.question_bn: 10 mol monatomic ideal-gas constant pressure heat 50RJ যোগ। ΔU কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। IsobaricQ=n CpΔT,Cp5R/2,Cv3R/2। ΔU/Q=Cv/Cp=3/5⇒ΔU30RJ; amount cancel,work 20R।

questions.question_bn: ConstantpowerP=3 W acceleratesmass 2kgfromrest,noresistance। t=4s-এ speed² কত?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Balanced reaction অনুযায়ী OCl⁻:I₂=1:1। iodide coefficient 2 হলেও iodine molecules (27) mol; redox electron balance 2।

questions.question_bn: Ore140g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(14)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।

questions.question_bn: Na₂CO₃amount 5mmol excessHCl-এ। atSTP 22.4L/mol,CO₂volume কত mL?

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 200g,dry mass 160g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(20)/(10×(20))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 76mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 19mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। HClconsumed=4×(19)−(19)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=28D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

options: Cl⁻ Al Cl₃-এ ছোট হয়ে proton হারায়

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=5 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=5L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(5)−0.04×(5)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Acidic Cr₂O₇²⁻ 4mmol→2Cr³⁺। total electron accepted কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Two Cr each+6→+3 needs 3electron; anion total 6electron。 oxygenbalance H⁺/waterdoesnotchangeelectrons।

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 21mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Charge-balanced salt requires 2monovalent carboxylate per Ca²⁺। nmmol Ca consumes 2×(21) mmolsoap।

questions.question_bn: MX₂(s)⇌M²⁺+2X⁻। pure-water molar solubility s=26×10⁻⁴M। Ksp কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Ion concentrations s,2s। Ksp=s(2s)²=4s³=4×(26)³×10⁻¹²; stoichiometric coefficient squared।

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=7/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Ecell=Ecathode(reduction)−Eanode(reduction)=(7)/10−(−0.2)=((7)+2)/10 V; addoppositesigns।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=12 mol,H₂=24 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(12))/3,availableN₂(12) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(12)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Reaction-এ bonds broken total 1600kJ/mol, formed 1920kJ/mol। approximate ΔH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Bond enthalpy estimate ΔH=Σbroken−Σformed=100×(16)−120×(16)=−20×(16); bond formation releases energy।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 27%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Convertedmass 1000·(27)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।

questions.question_bn: Ethanol concentratedH₂SO₄170°C-এ প্রধান product কী?

questions.question_bn: A(g)⇌2B(g), Kc=22। RT=2L·atm/mol stated। Kp কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Kp=Kc(RT)^Δ(22); Δ(22)=2−1=1। তাই Kp=2×(22), stoichiometric gas mole difference জরুরি।

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺electrolysistheoreticalmass 70g,actual 56g। current efficiency কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Currentefficiencyactualdesireddeposit/theoretical same charge=4×(14)/(5×(14))×100=80%; sidereactionsconsumeothercharge।

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=295.20000000000005L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। (24)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(24)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(24)/24.6=(24) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 4×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (4)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((4)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic mono alkyne C8H14। total sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Carbon skeleton (8)−1sigma ও hydrogen 2×(8)−2sigma। total 3×(8)−3; triple bond contains oneσ andtwoπ।

questions.question_bn: 25°C,cellnₑ=2,Q=1000। E°−E কত V? 0.0592 V factoruse

questions.question_bn: Electron momentum 31p₀। wavelength ratio λ/λ₀ কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। de Broglie λ=h/p। momentum factor (31)⇒wavelength factor 1/(31); kinetic energy ratio হলে square-root লাগত।

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 8 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 4 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Initial H⁺0.2×(4) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(4) mmol; excess 0.1×(4) mmol,total 3×(4) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।

questions.question_bn: 2SO₂+O₂→2SO₃। SO₂amount 31molfullyconvert। oxygen needed কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। CoefficientratioO₂:SO₂=1:2। needn/2molO₂; oxygen atom count molecular count distinct ion।

questions.question_bn: Propene+HBr, per oxide absent। major product কী?
questions.explanation: Ionic Markovnikov addition-এ secondary carbocation favoured। Br⁻ middlecarbon-এ attaches; radical per oxide mechanism এখানে absent।

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 42k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(22)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=3, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: H₂O-এর boiling point H₂S থেকে বেশি কেন?
questions.explanation: H₂O-তে electronegative O ও O–H group intermolecular hydrogen bonds দেয়। stronger intermolecular attraction overcome করতে বেশি heat লাগে।
